input.root_cause: The LoadCustomerDim SSIS job was killed as a deadlock victim while writing to the customer_dim table.
input.downstream_impact: Nightly customer dimension refresh delayed; one downstream reporting job depends on this data.

input.root_cause: The notification delivery queue's consumer process has stalled; queue depth has been climbing for 30 minutes with no messages being processed.
input.downstream_impact: Operator notifications for other incidents are backing up and being delayed.

input.root_cause: The CoreOpsApi worker process (w3wp.exe) has a memory leak; available memory has dropped steadily over the last 20 minutes with no recovery.
input.downstream_impact: Two internal services depend on this API; response times will degrade until it's addressed, though it hasn't failed outright yet.

input.root_cause: The primary prod-sql-01 instance has stopped responding to any connections; the secondary replica is healthy and fully in sync as of the last check.
input.downstream_impact: All six systems depending on prod-sql-01 are currently down; this is customer-facing.

input.root_cause: SQL Server is reporting page-level checksum failures on the orders table, consistent with underlying disk corruption.
input.downstream_impact: Order processing is failing intermittently; customer-facing.
